summary: The diff implements get Map.prototype.size. Step 1 binds this, step 2 calls this_map (the RequireInternalSlot equivalent) with ?, and step 5 returns Ok(Value::Number(count as f64)). Step 3/4 is replaced by map_table(agent, m).len() with a comment saying OrderedTable tracks its non-empty entry count. The spec's counting loop has no observable operations, so this shortcut is acceptable as long as len() excludes tombstoned (empty-key) entries. I could not see the support::collections helpers, so that is unverified. Renaming args/new_target to _args/_new_target is needed because they are now unused, not an unrelated change. No special-casing, no made-up values, no swallowed errors.
notes_for_next_attempt: Not a defect as far as the diff shows, but the reviewer could not see crates/kahvi-builtins/src/support/collections.rs. Confirm that OrderedTable::len() (the helper behind map_table(...).len()) returns only live entries and excludes deleted (empty-key) slots. If it returns the raw slot count including tombstones, this change is wrong after any delete. The test262 size tests that exercise delete are currently blocked on Map.prototype.delete being not-implemented, so they would not catch this yet.
